newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel sees positive developments in 97.
newsitem.headline: Henkel sees positive developments in 97.

text.p: German chemicals group Henkel KGaA, fresh from announcing various acquisitions, on Monday reported a stronger 1996 dividend and forecast pleasing business developments in 1997 as well.
"Henkel's management is very pleased with 1996 results and expects ongoing positive developments in the current year," the group said in a mandatory statement.

Henkel, which has been aggressively expanding its portfolio with a number of high-profile international acquisitions including U.S. group Loctite over the last months, said it would raise its dividend on ordinary shares to 1.20 marks from 1.05 marks.
The dividend for preference shares will be raised to 1.30 marks from 1.15 marks.
